segments.text: BLeſſed are all they that feare the Lorde: and walke in his wayes.
For thou ſhalt eate the labors of thine handes: O well is thee, and happy ſhalt thou be.
Thy wyfe ſhall be as the fruitfull vine: vpon the walles of thyne houſe.
Thy children lyke the Oliue braunches: round about thy table.
Loe, thus ſhall the man be bleſſed: that feareth the Lord.
The Lorde from out of Sion, ſhall ſo bleſſe thee: that thou ſhalt ſee Ieruſalem in proſperitie all thy lyfe long.
Yea that thou ſhalt ſee thy childers children: and peace vpon Iſrael.
Glory be to the father, and to the ſonne: and to the holy goſt.
As it was in the beginnyng, is nowe and euer ſhalbe: worlde without ende. Amen.
